description: This PHP class 'HoursField' extends 'AbstractField' and represents a scheduler hour field in a cron expression. It includes methods for checking satisfaction, incrementing hours while handling timezone and DST considerations, and validating the input value.

classes.name: HoursField
classes.description: Represents an hours field within cron schedule expressions, supporting wildcards, ranges, and increments.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the provided DateTime object satisfies the hours condition based on the cron value.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments or decrements the hour of the DateTime object, adjusting for timezone and DST transitions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cron hours value against a regex pattern for allowed syntax.
